finding.observation: The initial width table missed U+2329 and U+1B000. Ink could wrap logical lines again and conceal their suffixes outside the scroll range.
finding.resolution: Reserve two terminal cells conservatively for non-ASCII graphemes; keep standalone combining marks at zero cells. Narrow Unicode may wrap early without losing content.
finding.regression: Every END suffix in 20 worktrees containing each affected character remains reachable through rendered 80-column viewports.

sigterm_repair_review.root_cause: A once SIGTERM handler disappeared before Ink's already-dispatched signal-exit callback could inspect listener ownership; it could re-send SIGTERM before the Manager's finally restored the screen.
sigterm_repair_review.resolution: Keep the Manager handler registered with process.on until existing finally cleanup removes it after restoration. requestExit remains idempotent.
sigterm_repair_review.regression: Invoke the actual registered raw listener and assert it remains registered before finally, then is removed after restoration.
